source_title: Karma Automotive Announces Eximius, the Bespoke Vehicle Program for Elite Clients Seeking Singular Expressions of Extreme Performance and Bold Craftsmanship
source_excerpt:
The First Eximius Creation, "Eximius 1," is a Menacing Four-Seater Built for the Track which Makes its World Premiere at the 2026 Concours at Wynn Las Vegas
LAS VEGAS , Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Karma Automotive builds vehicles in the hundreds rather than the thousands, attracting a highly individualistic clientele seeking a unique statement. For those who wish to go further still, and explore new possibilities beyond the extensive options for personalization available through the Studio program, Karma has created the Eximius bespoke vehicle program. Eximius clients may modify the vehicle's body, performance and powertrain, collaborating with Karma's design and engineering teams to build a One-of-One statement which will never be repeated.
The first vehicle from Karma Eximius debuts today at the 2026 Concours at Wynn Las Vegas. A menacing four-seater purpose-built for the track, "Eximius 1" is in ongoing development with its commissioning client, who is not revealed at this time. Upon delivery in 2027, "Eximius 1" will be fitted with an extreme-performance Plug-in Series Hybrid utilizing a 6.2 Liter V8 producing nearly 1200hp (550hp ICE, 645hp battery), delivering acceleration from 0-60mph in 2.7 seconds and a top speed in excess of 200mph (estimated). As these parameters would demand, "Eximius 1" will be equipped with carbon-ceramic brakes and two-piece slotted brake rotors, and Ohlins semi-active suspension.
"'Eximius 1' began as a conversation with an elite client who loves their Karma Revero, but wanted something more extreme and unexpected, which was music to our ears," says Marques McCammon, President and Chief Executive, Karma Automotive. "The Eximius program effectively deletes the word 'no' from conversations about what's possible," he continues, "and as a four-seat track weapon packing what'll be the most powerful Plug-in Series Hybrid powertrain and vehicle ever developed, 'Eximius 1' shatters expectations and further establishes Karma as a manufacturer of exotic, uniquely American vehicles."
Exterior Design "Eximius 1" is an imposing vehicle to behold, exhibiting the muscularity and eyepopping strength of a superhero. Every panel â excluding the body surface outer â is constructed of pre-impregnated carbon fiber, and the vehicle is 50mm wider due to its wheel arch extensions. The front doors and hood have a unique technical fade from glossy, exposed regular carbon fiber to signature Borealis Blue paint.
The front carbon splitter sets an aggressive tone and is flanked by massive side air intakes incorporating Karma's Target Acquisition Lighting, rotated 45Âº to create a distinctive '><' DRL graphic identity. On the hood, the dramatic arc of the Comet Line â which is inspired by Halley's Comet is it streaks across the evening sky â widens from its apex towards the base of the windshield; vents above the front fenders release air pressure from the wheel housings and add further visual intrigue. Moving to the side of the vehicle, the front fenders aft of the wheels feature Karma's signature "Backslash" bearing the number "5," which is of particular significance to the commissioning client. 21" Magnesium wheels with center-locks reduce rotating and unsprung mass, and are finished in satin black. Aft of the driver's side front wheel, twin exhaust tips announce the fearsome new powertrain.
The full-width rear GT wing maximizes stability and downforce at high speeds, and continues the distinctive '><' DRL graphic identity established at the front of "Eximius 1." The rear fascia also boasts large side air intakes which are connected by a dominant diffuser to manage underbody airflow.
Interior Design An aura of intensity continues to the interior of " Eximius 1." In concert with the exterior, blue-tinted carbon-fiber adorns the seats, flat-bottom steering wheel and doors; for aesthetics and weight-savings, all four doors are manufactured in exposed carbon fiber with one purposeful arm pad on each door. The seats, which are Recaro carbon fiber buckets up front, are trimmed with blue Alcantara and blue Italian leather with Moondust Alcantara upper sections, creating an articulated, form-fitted feel. To support high-speed driving and intense braking force, the accelerator, brake pedal and dead pedal are billet machined aluminum.
The instrument panel is reimagined in glossy carbon fiber and incorporates anodized billet aluminum HVAC vents. The carbon fiber center console is simplified to include the essentials only: the PRND gear selector, window switches, key fob holder, and Emergency kill switch. This console extends through to the rear compartment, to which the client's custom-fitted carbon fiber racing helmet is held in place by a center-latched strap matching the blue seat belts.
About Karma Automotive Karma Automotive is America's only full-line ultra-luxury vehicle manufacturer, and a pioneer of Plug-in Series Hybrid vehicles which it manufactures at its Karma Innovation and Customization Center (KICC) in Moreno Valley, CA. Its Executive, Product Development, and Design headquarters are located in nearby Irvine, CA. The Karma portfolio embodies California's spirit of innovation and entrepreneurial boldness, reflected by the signature Comet Line which is the central hallmark of Karma's new design language. The Gyesera Grand Coupe, a Plug-in Series Hybrid four-seater, arrives at dealerships in December 2026; and the Amaris GT 2-Door Plug-in Series Hybrid arrives in Q4 2027. The Karma Kaveya Super Coupe, with over 1,000HP and butterfly-doors, will arrive in Q1 2028, to be followed by the Karma Ivara GT-UV: both EVs will incorporate SDVA (Software-Defined Vehicle Architecture) developed with leading technology partners. For more information, visit www.karmaautomotive.com )
